God is not up there.
God is not up there.
s1
And before you point at the sky... tell me. Up from where?
And before you point at the sky… tell me. Up from where?
s2
The Earth is a spinning ball. Point up in India. Someone points up in America. Completely different directions.
The Earth is a spinning ball. Point up in India. Someone points up in America. Completely different directions.
s3
So up there, is not a place. It just means, away from you.
So “up there” is not a place. It just means… away from you.
s4
We search far, because we assume, God is out there, and I am here.
We search far, because we assume: God is out there… and I am here.
s5
But look at the one who is searching.
But look at the one who is searching.
s6
Every temple, every mountain, every star you looked toward, you were already there first, looking.
Every temple, every mountain, every star you looked toward… you were already there first, looking.
s7
In the {छान्दोग्य} {उपनिषद्}, {उद्दालक} tells his son: put salt in water. Bring it to me in the morning.
In the Chāndogya Upaniṣad, Uddālaka tells his son: put salt in water. Bring it to me in the morning.
s8
The salt is gone. He can't see it. But taste the top. Salty. The middle. Salty. The bottom. Salty.
The salt is gone. He can't see it. But taste the top. Salty. The middle. Salty. The bottom. Salty.
s9
That subtle essence, the whole world is made of it. That is the Self. {तत् त्वम् असि}. You are that.
That subtle essence, the whole world is made of it. That is the Self. Tat tvam asi. You are that.
Not up there. Not even in here. Everywhere the salt is.
